assumption_to_test: A compact rollout-preview model can deterministically prove frozen-scope coverage and census arithmetic without executing or activating the proposed policy.
smallest_testable_validation: Add one proposed policy and a preview over the committed portable item population, including changed and unresolved outcomes, plus negative fixtures for omission, duplication, stale input, arithmetic, governance, and authority boundaries.
expected_learning: Whether rollout scope, replay inputs, outcome deltas, unresolved evidence, and governance can remain distinct and reproducible.
expected_cost: One qif-ledger schema slice, verifier rules, example data, retained fixtures, documentation, portable package, AOF evidence, and release.
success_threshold: All in-scope items reconcile exactly once; census values reproduce; incomplete or material changes trigger governance; full npm test passes.
